commitResults.messageTitle: Build: Bundle Apple Silicon JavaFX libraries
commitResults.messageBody:
The packaged application uses Intel macOS JavaFX artifacts. Those native
libraries do not match ARM-based Macs, so the bundled application cannot
run there without translation.

Use the mac-aarch64 classifier for every JavaFX module. Keeping the
platform classifiers consistent ensures the Shadow JAR contains native
libraries for its Apple Silicon target.

Recent feature work introduces import-order, Javadoc-placement, and line-wrapping violations that prevent Checkstyle from passing. Some task state also remains more visible and mutable than its callers require.

Correct the style violations and encapsulate immutable task details. Keeping those details private and final makes the task model easier to reason about while preserving its public behaviour.

commitResults.messageTitle: Storage: separate task parsing from file reading
commitResults.messageBody:
The load method handles file iteration, field validation, task construction, and completion state in one long block. These responsibilities obscure the storage workflow and make individual rules difficult to inspect.

Extract validation and task construction into focused helpers. The file format and user-facing errors remain unchanged while each part of parsing now has one clear purpose.

Pulbot relies on parsed tasks, initialized collaborators, and non-null storage inputs, but those assumptions are implicit. Violating one can produce a less focused failure later in execution.

Add Java assertions at the internal boundaries where those guarantees should already hold, and enable assertions during Gradle tests. Focused tests document the expected invariants without using assertions for recoverable user errors.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find command: use a stream for task matching
commitResults.messageBody:
Keyword matching performs filtering and output control in one mutable loop. The loop also tracks whether any result has appeared, which makes the empty-result path less direct.

Collect matching task indices with an IntStream before displaying them. Using indices preserves the original task numbers and ordering while separating selection from output behaviour.

Add concise Javadocs describing the copied collection and validated task input. This keeps the assertion intent visible to callers and restores Checkstyle compliance.

commitResults.messageTitle: Task list: reject duplicate task additions
commitResults.messageBody:
Pulbot accepts repeated copies of the same task, which can clutter the list and make completion state ambiguous. A duplicate needs to account for task type and schedule rather than description alone.

Compare identifying task details while ignoring description case, surrounding spaces, and completion state. Reject a duplicate before mutating or saving the list, retain compatibility with existing stored duplicates, and document the behaviour.
